content:
I was wondering whether lean (or lake) support dynamic imports in some way.

My goal is to be able to just create a .lean file in some folder, and have it imported (and used) automatically, e.g. with import Chapters.*.
The usecase is a Verso website, and it's only for convenience. Currently I have to create the file, import it, and then also reference it explicitly. I imagine it's feasible to access all imported files of some folder already and then use that, but as far as I can tell there is no way to skip the explicit import. The import syntax seems quite static.
